overall_assessment: Track 24 establishes a solid, contract-backed foundation for sandboxed WASI search provider components. The WIT interface definition in contracts/wit/search-provider.wit (package searchright:provider@0.1.0) strictly defines the types and provider-component world, ensuring clean host-guest boundary separation. The host SDK in searchright-plugin-sdk implements rigorous validation: ProviderComponentManifest validation, PROVIDER_ABI_VERSION pinning, BLAKE3 component byte digest verification, and granular capability checks via authorise_capability (ComponentCapability::Search, MetadataRead, NetworkRead). Resource envelopes (max_memory_mib, max_fuel) and host network allowlists are verified at admission. Deterministic integration tests in component_sandbox_scenarios.rs and component_edges.rs (25 unit and integration tests passing) confirm that byte tampering, ABI version mismatches, and undeclared capability requests fail closed.

findings.description: The WIT search-provider package world is pinned to searchright:provider/search-provider@0.1.0; runtime host dynamic ABI version negotiation is deferred to future multi-ABI plugin discovery tracks.
findings.recommendation: Maintain ABI version pinning until multi-version component registries are introduced.

findings.description: ProviderComponentManifest declares max_memory_mib and max_fuel resource bounds which are verified during manifest admission; active hardware fuel consumption metering and memory traps inside a live guest require the compiled Wasmtime runtime engine.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the open Wasmtime execution gate without claiming live runtime resource throttling.

findings.description: Integration test scenarios in component_sandbox_scenarios.rs and component_edges.rs thoroughly prove Ed25519 signature verification, component byte tampering rejection, least-privilege capability failure, key revocation enforcement, and validity window boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Enforce capability authorization checks as mandatory prerequisites before component invocation in all future runners.

assertions_evaluated.notes: WIT host/guest search-provider contract and Ed25519 signed manifest release verification implemented in searchright-plugin-sdk and proven with 25 unit and integration tests.

Component capability controls (ComponentCapability), memory bounds (max_memory_mib), fuel allocations (max_fuel), and network allowlists statically verified; live Wasmtime resource controls preserved as open gate.

calibration_notes: WASI systems architects confirm that WIT contract interfaces, Ed25519 signature admission, and static memory/fuel boundary validation are robustly implemented. Live guest Wasmtime execution and fuel metering remain preserved as open gates.
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only. Exact provider-component bytes, manifest identity, Ed25519 key authority, validity windows, and capability checks are compiler-tested locally; live Wasmtime runtime execution, fuel limits, and guest capability enforcement remain open gates.
